rules.name: Syntax error
rules.description: The parser could not read the source code.

rules.name: Unused suppression
rules.description: An lsp-ignore comment suppresses no finding and can be removed.

rules.name: Bidirectional control character
rules.description: Bidirectional control characters can make code display differently from how it compiles (Trojan Source).

rules.name: Invisible character
rules.description: Invisible or zero-width characters in the source code.

rules.name: Control character
rules.description: NUL or control characters or invalid bytes (U+FFFD) in the source code.

rules.name: Confusable identifier
rules.description: Identifiers that mix scripts or contain non-ASCII characters can be confused with others.

rules.name: Unit name does not match file name
rules.description: The name in the unit line differs from the file name, so the compiler cannot find the unit through uses.

rules.name: Forbidden uses
rules.description: A uses entry violates a layer rule configured under "layers" in delphi-lsp.json, e.g. *.Common.* must not use Vcl.*.
